overview.about: LIV Golf Andalucia is staged at Real Club Valderrama near Sotogrande, the fearsome Robert Trent Jones design that hosted the 1997 Ryder Cup. Tight, tree-lined and famous for its treacherous par-5 17th, it is one of the toughest courses the LIV series visits.
overview.nextEvent: The next LIV Golf Andalucia is contested over 54 holes at Valderrama, with the individual and team titles decided across three days. The demanding cork-oak-lined layout tends to produce higher scoring than most LIV stops.
